summary: Prototype rules compile and are deployed; real staff, anonymous, draft and upload scenarios still require end-to-end verification.

findings.issue: Rules check date format and ordering, while actual calendar validity is enforced by the web client. A trusted staff API write can still supply a nonexistent calendar date.
findings.recommendation: Consider timestamp-based dates or a trusted publishing endpoint if direct staff API writes become part of the workflow.

findings.issue: Public image path manifests are bounded and storage-scoped, but trusted staff can list extra files from the same exhibition folder.
findings.recommendation: For a stricter editorial publishing workflow, derive image manifests in a trusted publishing endpoint.
